marta: Quick check-in  I'm combining the scattered 429 + timeout SDK examples into one canonical snippet and fixing a few errref links.
sam: 👍 please use the canonical `retry-after` header and current SDK call shape (responses.create).
marta: will do. plan: show exponential backoff + jitter, honor retry-after when present, then a final fallback to a smaller model.
lia: product wants a short note about context limits trimming answers silently and how to debug.
marta: proposed copy: 'If output is truncated, check token usage and enable context trimming or split the prompt. Consider a larger-context model for persistent truncation.'
kevin: small nit: normalize header casing in sample (Retry-After vs retry-after).
marta: good catch  i'll read both keys in the snippet.
doc-bot: draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/601  deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-601--docs.redwood.ai/errref/429-timeouts
sam: i'll review for SDK naming standards.
kevin: i'll review the redirect entries for old KB slugs tomorrow.
marta: thanks all, merging after two approvals :shipit:
